name: Tokyo Innovation Base
address: Tokyo 100-0005 Tokyo Innovation Base, 3-8-3 Marunouchi, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
accessSummary: 1 min walk from Yurakucho Station (JR Yamanote Line / Keihin-Tohoku Line), Kyobashi Exit; right at Exit D9 of Yurakucho Station (Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line); 3 min walk from Exit 1 of Ginza-itchome Station (Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line)
hours: Open Weekdays 10:00-21:00, Sat, Sun & holidays 10:00-17:00 (until 22:00 when an event is held). Last entry 30 min before closing
notice: Only registered TIB Partner organizations can hold events and seminars (registration takes 2-3 months; requests less than 1 month before the event date cannot be accepted).

ops.catering: Outside food/drink brought in is allowed only for light, odorless snacks for personal consumption (such as rice balls and sandwiches) and beverages. Alcohol may not be brought in as a rule, but if it is necessary for an event or seminar, an organizer such as a TIB Partner may bring it in with approval from the secretariat. (Source: FAQ, Facility Terms of Use revised May 8, 2025)
ops.restaurants: There is a CAFE & BAR and a SHOP on the 1st floor of the building. There are no vending machines in the building.
ops.parking: The facility has no parking or bicycle parking; use paid parking lots and similar facilities in the surrounding area. (Source: Facility Terms of Use revised May 8, 2025)
